name: Carp
soul: The soul of one who swims against the current as a matter of course, and has never thought to call it hard.
spark: The mote holds its place a little upwind of you in any draught, as if the air were going somewhere and it had declined.

hybrid.text: It holds its place in whatever is going past it, and has not yet been carried off.

settled.name: Fingerling
settled.text: A fish the length of your finger, mostly eye. It hangs in the air at your shoulder with its nose to whatever is coming.
settled.sign: The length of your finger, and mostly eye. It always faces into the draught, working its tail to stay where it is.
settled.habit: It holds its place over the washbasin for an hour at a time, and looks pleased with itself.

paths.name: Weir-leaper
paths.of: one who does not go round
paths.text: It learned from you that the way round is longer than it looks. It goes over; and if it falls back, it goes over again.
paths.sign: Scales thick as coin along the shoulder, a nose scuffed pale, and a body bent like a drawn bow.
paths.habit: It throws itself at the top stair, falls short, and does it again until it is on the landing.

prongs.name: Falls-climber
prongs.of: one who keeps climbing after everyone has said it is high enough
prongs.text: On the deep runs it goes up each fall ahead of you and waits in the slack above, looking down.
prongs.sign: Whiskers grown long and swept back, a longer body, and a look upward even on level ground.
prongs.habit: It noses at the ceiling in the corners, where the wall stops, as if there might be more.

finishes.name: Horn-bud
finishes.of: one who is changed by the climb before they reach the top
finishes.text: Each blow you take on the deep runs it takes with you, and something has begun to come through above its eyes.
finishes.sign: Two blunt buds above the eyes, soft as new antler, and the start of a mane behind them.
finishes.habit: It rubs its brow along the lintel of every door it passes under, slowly, on both sides.

finishes.name: Past-the-Gate
finishes.of: one who came through, and is still surprised by their own reflection
finishes.text: Every named beast you felled was a fall it went up. After the last, what looked out of its face had horns.
finishes.sign: Long as a banner, maned and whiskered, with antlers of horn; and a carp's round, mild eye.
finishes.habit: It still turns into the draught and holds its place there, though nothing could move it now.

prongs.name: Rapids-runner
prongs.of: one who is quickest where it is roughest
prongs.text: It is through the gap in the foe's swing before the swing has finished. You go where it went.
prongs.sign: Narrow as a blade, with a deep forked tail. It is never quite still, even asleep.
prongs.habit: It shoots the length of the corridor when a door bangs, and comes back slowly, as if it had meant to.

finishes.name: White-water
finishes.of: one who looks calmest in the middle of the worst of it
finishes.text: In the thick of a party's fight it hangs quite still, and the blows go round it like water round a stone.
finishes.sign: Pale as foam at fins and tail, and a line of spray that hangs in the air behind it.
finishes.habit: It rests in the one place in a crowd where nobody is pushing.

finishes.name: Skimmer
finishes.of: one who leaves the water when the water is not enough
finishes.text: From far off it leaves the current altogether, and comes down on the far side of whatever stood between you and the foe.
finishes.sign: Fins at its shoulders grown long as wings and held out flat. It travels in long low arcs.
finishes.habit: It launches from the back of your chair and glides to the windowsill every evening, and sometimes misses.

prongs.name: Shoal-head
prongs.of: one who goes first into it so the rest have slack water to follow in
prongs.text: It takes the front of the party and the worst of the current, and your classmates come up easier in its wake.
prongs.sign: A broad blunt head and heavy shoulders, and a wake that shows in the air behind it.
prongs.habit: It goes through every doorway first and waits just inside, facing back the way it came.

finishes.name: Cutwater
finishes.of: one who stands where it hits hardest, so that behind them it is calm
finishes.text: It sets itself across the rush as you set your guard, and the blow breaks on its shoulders. Behind it your friends have room to breathe.
finishes.sign: A head like a prow, plated grey as harbour stone, and still water in the lee of it.
finishes.habit: It lies across the threshold when the wind gets up, and the draught goes round.

finishes.name: Shoal-elder
finishes.of: one who turns back at the top to show the small ones the way
finishes.text: On escorts a shoal of small lights follows in its wake. It counts them at every halt, and goes back for the last.
finishes.sign: A dozen fry no longer than a thumbnail swim in its wake, and scatter and regather when it turns.
finishes.habit: It will not settle for the night until every one of the small ones is under its fins.

paths.name: Still-water Carp
paths.of: one who makes a small place deep by staying in it
paths.text: It learned from you that a pool is as deep as the time you give it. It has stopped looking for the river.
paths.sign: A pale body with patches like spilled lacquer, and a slow turn at the end of every length, as if at a wall.
paths.habit: It swims the same circuit of your room at the same hour, and is put out if a chair has moved.

prongs.name: Lacquer-back
prongs.of: one who wears who they are where anyone can read it
prongs.text: Each time your Pattern fires its markings come up brighter, and the foe cannot help looking.
prongs.sign: The patches have drawn together into one clean saddle and a mask, bright as wet lacquer.
prongs.habit: It turns broadside under the lamp and holds there until somebody has noticed.

finishes.name: Crane-crowned
finishes.of: one who has pared themselves down to a single true thing
finishes.text: All its markings have gone but one: a round red crown, the colour of the word you swore.
finishes.sign: White as paper, with one round red mark on the crown of its head and nothing else.
finishes.habit: It rises to the top of the room at first light and shows the mark to the east.

finishes.name: Brocade Carp
finishes.of: one who has been many things and kept the colours of all of them
finishes.text: Every Cast you threw left a colour on it. It has kept them all, laid one over another like brocade.
finishes.sign: Three colours laid over one another, and fins and tail so long they follow it round corners.
finishes.habit: It will not be hurried past a mirror.

prongs.name: Hand-fed Carp
prongs.of: one who comes when called, and is not ashamed of it
prongs.text: It comes to a classmate's hand as readily as to yours, and they fight the steadier for having fed it.
prongs.sign: Thick soft lips, and a way of rising mouth first to any hand held out flat.
prongs.habit: It knows the sound of the refectory bell, and is at the door before the bell has finished.

finishes.name: Hundred-winter Carp
finishes.of: one whom everyone has fed and nobody owns
finishes.text: The shades at the hearth know it by name. It was in this yard for their cohorts, in a way, and now it has seen yours.
finishes.sign: Very large and very slow, weed on its back, its whiskers gone white, and eyes that have watched a great many people.
finishes.habit: It lies near whoever is oldest in the room, and they both seem to rest.

finishes.name: Ring-bearer
finishes.of: one who can be trusted with what you cannot afford to lose
finishes.text: It carries your writs in a ring of light in its mouth, and has never once swallowed. What you give it to keep, it keeps.
finishes.sign: A ring of light held gently in its mouth, which it shifts from side to side like a sweet.
finishes.habit: It takes small things you have dropped and gives them back a day later, when you have stopped looking.

prongs.name: Ice-sleeper
prongs.of: one who can wait out a whole season without moving
prongs.text: When you turn the cold on a foe it goes still beside you and takes none of it. It has slept under worse.
prongs.sign: Fins folded close, a rime along its back, and a stillness you could mistake for a carving.
prongs.habit: In the cold months it hangs in one corner of the room for days, and wakes when you say its name twice.

finishes.name: Under-the-Ice
finishes.of: one who is most alive where nothing shows
finishes.text: When you block, a pane of ice forms over it like a window. It watches the blow land on that, and is not touched.
finishes.sign: A slab of clear ice rides over its back like a lid, and it looks up through it.
finishes.habit: It breathes on the window on cold mornings, from the inside, and watches the yard through the clear patch.

finishes.name: First Thaw
finishes.of: one who is the first thing moving when it is over
finishes.text: When your wards go up it breaks out of its stillness with the ice still on it, and everything near it wakes too.
finishes.sign: Shards of ice still ride on its back and melt as it goes, and its fins are spread as wide as they will open.
finishes.habit: It is at the window on the first warm morning, tapping the glass with its nose.

paths.name: Silt-reader
paths.of: one who finds out by touch, slowly, and is never surprised
paths.text: It learned from you that what happened is kept at the bottom of things. It goes down and feels for it.
paths.sign: A flat head, a wide slow mouth, and whiskers longer than itself that touch a thing before it does.
paths.habit: It lies along the skirting board with its whiskers out, and knows who came in while you were away.

prongs.name: Quake-fish
prongs.of: one who feels it coming through the floor
prongs.text: It feels the foe's weight shift before the foe has moved, and twitches; and you are already turning the blow.
prongs.sign: Its whiskers hang straight down like plumb lines, and tremble a moment before anything else does.
prongs.habit: It goes rigid a breath before the car passes, and a breath before the cup falls.

finishes.name: Anchor-stone
finishes.of: one who holds still so that everything else can
finishes.text: Set to Hold, it takes up a stone and lies under it. While it lies still, the ground under you does not move.
finishes.sign: A grey boulder roped to its back, worn smooth where the rope goes, and a patience that is nearly geology.
finishes.habit: It will not shift from where it has settled until you have asked it three times, politely.

finishes.name: Ground-shaker
finishes.of: one whose smallest movement is felt by everyone in the room
finishes.text: When your Pattern lands it rolls once, and the foe's footing goes out from under it.
finishes.sign: A great heavy head, and rings that spread in the air from its tail whenever it turns.
finishes.habit: It turns over in its sleep and the cups ring on the shelf.

prongs.name: Lamp-barbel
prongs.of: one who carries the only light there is down there, and chooses who sees by it
prongs.text: On the night runs it goes ahead with a light on the end of one whisker, held low, so that only you can see by it.
prongs.sign: One whisker grown long as a rod, with a small steady light at its tip, carried out in front.
prongs.habit: It reads over your shoulder at night, holding its light just clear of the page.

finishes.name: Wreck-light
finishes.of: one who makes a home in what went down, and keeps a lamp in the window
finishes.text: It lives in what the old world left under the water, and comes out of the ruins with a lamp grown into its back.
finishes.sign: A ship's lamp is grown into its back among barnacles and weed, and still burns.
finishes.habit: It sleeps inside anything hollow: a boot, a helmet, the stove when it is cold.

finishes.name: Well-watcher
finishes.of: one who has only ever seen a coin of sky, and knows it by heart
finishes.text: On Guard it looks up, always. It sees the strike that comes from above before you have thought to look.
finishes.sign: Round as a float, with great eyes set on the top of its head that look only upward.
finishes.habit: It lies on the floor under the skylight for whole afternoons, watching the square of sky go by.

prongs.name: Doctor-fish
prongs.of: one whom the hurt come and lean against
prongs.text: When you have taken a blow for the party it comes and lays its side against you until your hands are steady.
prongs.sign: Small scales under a thick clear slime that shines green-gold, and a calm that the hurt drift towards.
prongs.habit: It lies against whichever of you has had the worst day, saying nothing.

finishes.name: Salve-carp
finishes.of: one who gives away what protects them, and grows it back
finishes.text: It has leaned against every classmate who was ever hurt beside you, and its own sides are worn bright with it.
finishes.sign: Its sides are worn bare in patches where others have leaned, and shine there like new metal.
finishes.habit: It goes down the row of beds at night and touches each sleeper once, as if counting.

finishes.name: Mud-sleeper
finishes.of: one who shuts themselves away to get through the lean time, and comes out whole
finishes.text: Alone in the dead places it shuts itself in a ball of mud and waits. You have learned to wait with it.
finishes.sign: A ball of dried mud with a crack in it, a tail curled round the outside, and one eye looking out of the crack.
finishes.habit: It builds a nest of your blankets, goes in, and is not seen for two days. Then it is hungry.

newFeatures.label: fins long as a court sleeve
a pane of ice over its back
